title: How AI social responsibility shapes consumers’ brand advocacy
core_idea: This study aims to conceptualize and validate a two-dimensional structure of AI social responsibility (technical vs. institutional), develop corresponding measurement scales, and investigate the mechanisms through which these AISR dimensions influence consumer brand advocacy—focusing on perceived AI credibility and perceived AI empathy as mediators and AI literacy as a moderator—using mixed methods (in-depth interviews with grounded theory, survey-based factor analyses, and experimental studies).
tldr: Mixed-methods study to define and validate technical and institutional AISR and to test how these dimensions connect to consumer brand advocacy via perceived AI credibility and empathy, with AI literacy as a boundary condition.
